capture.zh: 穿上高压水枪套装，用头部射击酒鬼克莱芬后直接进入对战；战斗胜利后获得克莱芬精元。

strategy_notes.zh: 第一次对战的克莱芬处于酒醉状态，「弱不禁风」，攻略作者直接用炎魔解决。

engine_notes: Pre-battle requirement: player must wear the 高压水枪 suit and shoot the boss with the head item; model as an unlock flag (item_suit_high_pressure_water_gun) rather than a battle rule.
Level and HP of the drunk first fight are not published; 60 / 2000 are estimates for a deliberately weak first fight.
skills: sources name no (or only some) boss skills; the team uses the species' four top learnset skills (Lv49-61). Every 2011-2012 SPT boss whose skills a source does list used exactly these four.
reward: original reward was the species' 精元 (essence), hatched in the 分子转化器 into the base form (e.g. 兰斯特 精元 → 卡斯, 伊索里 → 伊索的精元); encoded as the base-form species at Lv1.
source_note: 4399 (2011-08 compilation) describes a two-step quest: drunk fight (gives 精元) then an 80级 rematch (achievement).
